items.source: Variant of setAllowedMethods(List) for adding one allowed method at a time.
items.translation: 为逐个添加允许的 HTTP 方法而设计的 `setAllowedMethods(List)` 变体。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: A header name is not required to be listed if it is one of: Cache-Control, Content-Language, Expires, Last-Modified, or Pragma.
items.translation: 如果头名称是以下之一，则不需要列出： Cache-Control、Content-Language、Expires、 Last-Modified 或 Pragma。

items.source: Validate that when allowCredentials is true, allowedOrigins does not contain the special value "*" since in that case the "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" cannot be set to "*".
items.translation: 验证当allowCredentials为true时，allowedOrigins不包含特殊值"*"，因为在这种情况下无法将"Access-Control-Allow-Origin"设置为"*"。

items.source: Validate that when allowPrivateNetwork is true, allowedOrigins does not contain the special value "*" since this is insecure.
items.translation: 验证当 `allowPrivateNetwork` 为 `true` 时，`allowedOrigins` 不包含特殊值 `"*"`，因为这是不安全的。

items.source: Variant of setAllowedHeaders(List) for adding one allowed header at a time.
items.translation: 为逐个添加允许的标头而设计的 `setAllowedHeaders(List)` 变体。

items.source: Variant of setAllowedOrigins(List) for adding one origin at a time.
items.translation: 为逐个添加源而设计的 `setAllowedOrigins(List)` 变体。

items.source: Variant of setAllowedOriginPatterns(List) for adding one origin at a time.
items.translation: 为逐个添加源而设计的 `setAllowedOriginPatterns(List)` 变体。

items.source: Variant of setExposedHeaders(List) for adding one exposed header at a time.
items.translation: 为逐个添加暴露头而设计的 `setExposedHeaders(List)` 变体。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the validation fails
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果验证失败

items.source: In contrast to allowedOrigins which only supports "*" and cannot be used with allowCredentials or allowPrivateNetwork, when an allowedOriginPattern is matched, the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header is set to the matched origin and not to "*" nor to the pattern. Therefore, allowedOriginPatterns can be used in combination with setAllowCredentials(Boolean) and setAllowPrivateNetwork(Boolean) set to true.
items.translation: 与仅支持 "*" 且无法与 allowCredentials 或 allowPrivateNetwork 一起使用的 allowedOrigins 不同，当匹配到 allowedOriginPattern 时，Access-Control-Allow-Origin 响应头会被设置为匹配的源，而不是 "*" 或模式本身。因此，allowedOriginPatterns 可以与 setAllowCredentials(Boolean) 和 setAllowPrivateNetwork(Boolean)（设置为 true）结合使用。

items.source: For matched pre-flight and actual requests the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header is set either to the matched domain value or to "*". Keep in mind however that the CORS spec does not allow "*" when allowCredentials is set to true, and does not recommend "*" when allowPrivateNetwork is set to true. As a consequence, those combinations are rejected in favor of using allowedOriginPatterns instead.
items.translation: 对于匹配的预检和实际请求，`Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 响应头会被设置为匹配到的域值或 `"*"`。但请注意，当 allowCredentials 被设置为 `true` 时，CORS 规范不允许使用 `"*"`；当 allowPrivateNetwork 被设置为 `true` 时，也不推荐使用 `"*"。因此，这些组合将被拒绝，转而使用 allowedOriginPatterns。

items.source: Combining lists like allowedOrigins, allowedMethods, allowedHeaders or exposedHeaders is done in an additive way. For example, combining ["GET", "POST"] with ["PATCH"] results in ["GET", "POST", "PATCH"]. However, combining ["GET", "POST"] with ["*"] results in ["*"]. Note also that default permit values set by applyPermitDefaultValues() are overridden by any explicitly defined values.
items.translation: 合并列表（如 `allowedOrigins`、`allowedMethods`、`allowedHeaders` 或 `exposedHeaders`）是以累加方式进行的。例如，将 `["GET", "POST"]` 与 `["PATCH"]` 合并会得到 `["GET", "POST", "PATCH"]`。然而，将 `["GET", "POST"]` 与 `["*"]` 合并会得到 `["*"]`。此外，请注意由 applyPermitDefaultValues() 设置的默认允许值会被任何显式定义的值覆盖。

items.source: Setting this property has an impact on how origins, originPatterns, allowedMethods and allowedHeaders are processed, see related API documentation for more details.
items.translation: 设置此属性会影响 origins、originPatterns、allowedMethods 和 allowedHeaders 的处理方式，有关详细信息请参阅相关 API 文档。

items.source: Access-Control-Allow-Methods response header is set either to the configured method or to "*". Keep in mind however that the CORS spec does not allow "*" when allowCredentials is set to true, that combination is handled by copying the method specified in the CORS preflight request.
items.translation: `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` 响应头设置为配置的请求方法或 `"*"。但请注意，当 allowCredentials 设置为 `true` 时，CORS 规范不允许使用 `"*"；该组合通过复制 CORS 预检请求中指定的方法来处理。

items.source: Access-Control-Allow-Headers response header is set either to the configured list of headers or to "*". Keep in mind however that the CORS spec does not allow "*" when allowCredentials is set to true, that combination is handled by copying the headers specified in the CORS preflight request.
items.translation: `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` 响应头设置为配置的请求头列表或 `"*"`。但请注意，当 allowCredentials 设置为 true 时，CORS 规范不允许使用 `"*"`；该组合通过复制 CORS 预检请求中指定的请求头来处理。

items.source: Access-Control-Expose-Headers response header is set either to the configured list of headers or to "*". While the CORS spec does not allow "*" when Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is set to true, most browsers support it and the response headers are not all available during the CORS processing, so as a consequence "*" is the header value used when specified regardless of the value of the `allowCredentials` property.
items.translation: Access-Control-Expose-Headers 响应头被设置为配置的头部列表或 "*"。虽然 CORS 规范不允许在 Access-Control-Allow-Credentials 设置为 true 时使用 "*"，但大多数浏览器支持此用法，且并非所有响应头在 CORS 处理期间都可用，因此无论 `allowCredentials` 属性的值如何，只要指定了该头部，其值均为 "*"。

items.source: Setting this property has an impact on how origins and originPatterns are processed, see related API documentation for more details.
items.translation: 设置此属性会影响对 `origins` 和 `originPatterns` 的处理方式，有关详细信息请参阅相关 API 文档。

items.source: When combining single values like allowCredentials or maxAge, this properties are overridden by non-null other properties if any.
items.translation: 当合并单个值（如 `allowCredentials` 或 `maxAge`）时，如果存在非空的 `other` 属性，它们将覆盖 `this` 属性。

items.source: By default a newly created CorsConfiguration does not permit any cross-origin requests and must be configured explicitly to indicate what should be allowed. Use applyPermitDefaultValues() to flip the initialization model to start with open defaults that permit all cross-origin requests for GET, HEAD, and POST requests.
items.translation: 默认情况下，新创建的 CorsConfiguration 不允许任何跨域请求，必须显式配置以指示允许的内容。使用 applyPermitDefaultValues() 将初始化模型切换为开放默认值，从而允许 GET、HEAD 和 POST 请求的所有跨域请求。

items.source: By default this is not set which means that no origins are allowed. However, an instance of this class is often initialized further, for example, for @CrossOrigin, via applyPermitDefaultValues().
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值未设置，这意味着不允许任何源。然而，该类的实例通常会被进一步初始化，例如用于@CrossOrigin，通过applyPermitDefaultValues()。

items.source: If not set, only "GET" and "HEAD" are allowed.
items.translation: 如果未设置，仅允许使用"GET"和"HEAD"。

items.source: By default, this is not set (i.e. user credentials are not supported).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置（即不支持用户凭据）。

items.source:
Private network requests are requests whose target server's IP address is more private than
that from which the request initiator was fetched. For example, a request from a public website
(https://example.com) to a private website (https://router.local), or a request from a private
website to localhost.
items.translation: 私有网络请求是指目标服务器 IP 地址比发起该请求的客户端更私有的请求。例如，从公共网站（https://example.com）到私有网站（https://router.local）的请求，或从私有网站到本地主机（localhost）的请求。

items.source: By default, this is not set (i.e. private network access is not supported).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置（即不支持私有网络访问）。

items.source: The following defaults are applied for values that are not set:
items.translation: 对于未设置的值，将应用以下默认值：

items.source: Return the allowed HTTP methods, or null in which case only "GET" and "HEAD" allowed.
items.translation: 返回允许的 HTTP 方法，或返回 `null`，此时仅允许使用 `"GET"` 和 `"HEAD"`。

items.source: Construct a new CorsConfiguration instance by copying all values from the supplied CorsConfiguration.
items.translation: 通过复制提供的CorsConfiguration中的所有值来构建一个新的CorsConfiguration实例。

items.source: Return the configured allowCredentials flag, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回配置的 `allowCredentials` 标志，如果没有则返回 `null`。

items.source: Return the configured allowPrivateNetwork flag, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回配置的allowPrivateNetwork标志，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Return the configured maxAge value, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回配置的maxAge值，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Alternative to setAllowedOrigins(List) that supports more flexible origins patterns with "*" anywhere in the host name in addition to port lists.
items.translation: 替代 `setAllowedOrigins(List)` 的方法，支持更灵活的源模式，除了端口列表外，还允许在主机名中的任何位置使用 "*"。

items.source: Wildcard representing all origins, methods, or headers.
items.translation: 代表所有源、方法或标头的通配符。

items.source: Construct a new CorsConfiguration instance with no cross-origin requests allowed for any origin by default.
items.translation: 构建一个新的CorsConfiguration实例，默认情况下不允许任何源发起跨域请求。

items.source: Check the supplied request headers (or the headers listed in the Access-Control-Request-Headers of a pre-flight request) against the configured allowed headers.
items.translation: 检查提供的请求标头（或预检请求中列出的`Access-Control-Request-Headers` 中的标头）与配置的允许标头。

items.source: Check the HTTP request method (or the method from the Access-Control-Request-Method header on a pre-flight request) against the configured allowed methods.
items.translation: 检查 HTTP 请求方法（或在预检请求中来自`Access-Control-Request-Method` 头部的请求方法）与配置的允许方法是否匹配。

items.source: Return the allowed actual request headers, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回允许的请求头，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Return the configured origins patterns to allow, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回配置的允许源模式，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Return the configured origins to allow, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回允许的配置源，如果没有则返回null。

items.source: Return the configured response headers to expose, or null if none.
items.translation: 返回已配置为暴露的响应头，若无则返回null。

items.source: Check the origin of the request against the configured allowed origins.
items.translation: 检查请求的源是否与配置的允许源匹配。

items.source:
Configure how long, as a duration, the response from a pre-flight request
can be cached by clients.
items.translation: 配置客户端可以缓存预检请求响应的时长（以持续时间表示）。

items.source: Allow all origins with the special value "*" defined in the CORS spec. This is set only if neither origins nor originPatterns are already set.
items.translation: 允许 CORS 规范中定义的特殊值 `"*"` 作为所有来源。仅在未设置origins或originPatterns时才会设置此选项。

items.source: • Private network access specifications
items.translation: • 私有网络访问规范

items.source: the combined CorsConfiguration, or this configuration if the supplied configuration is null
items.translation: 合并的 `CorsConfiguration`，或者如果提供的配置为 `null` 则为 `this` 的配置

items.source: comma-delimited list of specific domains, for example, "https://a1.com,https://a2.com"; this is convenient when a value is resolved through a property placeholder, for example, "${origin}"; note that such placeholders must be resolved externally.
items.translation: 逗号分隔的特定域名列表，例如 `"https://a1.com,https://a2.com"`；当值通过属性占位符解析时（例如 `"${origin}"`），这种方式很方便；请注意，此类占位符必须在外部进行解析。

items.source: comma-delimited list of patters, for example, "https://*.a1.com,https://*.a2.com"; this is convenient when a value is resolved through a property placeholder, for example, "${origin}"; note that such placeholders must be resolved externally.
items.translation: 逗号分隔的模式列表，例如 `"https://*.a1.com,https://*.a2.com"`；当值通过属性占位符解析时（例如 `"${origin}"`），这种方式很方便；请注意，此类占位符必须在外部进行解析。

items.source: the list of HTTP methods to list in the response of a pre-flight request, or null if the supplied requestMethod is not allowed
items.translation: 预检请求响应中要列出的 HTTP 方法列表，或者如果提供的 `requestMethod` 不被允许则为 `null`。

items.source: a specific domain, for example, "https://domain1.com"
items.translation: 特定域，例如"https://domain1.com"

items.source: the CORS defined special value "*" for all origins
items.translation: CORS 定义的特殊值 "*" 适用于所有源。

items.source: origin - the origin to check
items.translation: origin - 要检查的源

items.source: the origin to use for the response, or null which means the request origin is not allowed
items.translation: 用于响应的源，或表示不允许请求源的 `null`。

items.source: requestMethod - the HTTP request method to check
items.translation: requestMethod - 要检查的 HTTP 请求方法

items.source: requestHeaders - the request headers to check
items.translation: requestHeaders - 要检查的请求头

items.source: the list of allowed headers to list in the response of a pre-flight request, or null if none of the supplied request headers is allowed
items.translation: 预检请求响应中允许列出的头列表，或者如果未允许任何提供的请求头，则为 `null`。

items.source: https://*.domain1.com -- domains ending with domain1.com
items.translation: https://*.domain1.com -- 以 domain1.com 结尾的域名

items.source:
https://*.domain1.com:[8080,8081] -- domains ending with
domain1.com on port 8080 or port 8081
items.translation: https://*.domain1.com:[8080,8081] -- 以 domain1.com 结尾的域名，端口为 8080 或 8081。

items.source:
https://*.domain1.com:[*] -- domains ending with
domain1.com on any port, including the default port
items.translation: https://*.domain1.com:[*] -- 以 domain1.com 结尾的域名，包括默认端口在内的任何端口。

items.source: Allow all headers.
items.translation: 允许所有标头。

items.source: Set max age to 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
items.translation: 将最大生存时间设置为 1800 秒（30 分钟）。

items.source: Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen, Ruslan Akhundov
items.translation: Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen, Ruslan Akhundov

items.source: NOTE: Be aware that this option establishes a high level of trust with the configured domains and also increases the surface attack of the web application by exposing sensitive user-specific information such as cookies and CSRF tokens.
items.translation: 注意： 请注意，此选项会与配置的域建立高度信任关系，同时也会增加 Web 应用程序的攻击面，因为它会暴露敏感的用户特定信息（如 Cookie 和 CSRF 令牌）。

items.source: By default, this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: Set the HTTP methods to allow, for example, "GET", "POST", "PUT", etc.
items.translation: 设置允许使用的 HTTP 方法，例如 `"GET"`、`"POST"`、`"PUT"` 等。

items.source: A list of origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed where each value may be one of the following: a specific domain, for example, "https://domain1.com" comma-delimited list of specific domains, for example, "https://a1.com,https://a2.com"; this is convenient when a value is resolved through a property placeholder, for example, "${origin}"; note that such placeholders must be resolved externally.
items.translation: 允许跨域请求的源列表，其中每个值可以是以下之一： 特定域名，例如 `"https://domain1.com"`； 逗号分隔的特定域名列表，例如 `"https://a1.com,https://a2.com"`；当值通过属性占位符解析时，此格式非常方便，例如 `"${origin}"`；请注意，此类占位符必须在外部进行解析。

items.source: By default CorsConfiguration does not permit any cross-origin requests and must be configured explicitly.
items.translation: 默认情况下，CorsConfiguration 不允许任何跨域请求，必须显式配置。

items.source: Combine the non-null properties of the supplied CorsConfiguration with this one.
items.translation: 合并提供的非空 CorsConfiguration 属性与此配置。

items.source: Whether user credentials are supported.
items.translation: 是否支持用户凭据。

items.source:
Set the list of headers that a pre-flight request can list as allowed
for use during an actual request.
items.translation: 设置预检请求可以列出的、在正式请求期间允许使用的标头列表。

items.source: Whether private network access is supported for user-agents restricting such access by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下，用户代理是否支持限制此类访问的私有网络访问。

items.source:
Set the list of response headers that an actual response might have
and can be exposed to the client.
items.translation: 设置实际响应可能具有并可暴露给客户端的响应头列表。

items.source:
Configure how long, in seconds, the response from a pre-flight request
can be cached by clients.
items.translation: 配置客户端可以缓存预检请求响应的时长（以秒为单位）。

items.translation: 字段详情
